find:
AdmissionResolution::Complete(receipt_json) => tx.execute(
                    "UPDATE task_admission SET state = 'complete', receipt_json = ?3

replace:
AdmissionResolution::Complete(receipt_json) => tx.execute(
                    "UPDATE task_admission SET state = 'pending', receipt_json = ?3

note: Recovery's Complete resolution writes the receipt but leaves the row pending: the recovered key no longer replays the byte-exact receipt and can never complete, so no admission is actually landed.
